headline: Aarey Drugs submits AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Routine procedural filing from Aarey Drugs
summary: Aarey Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. This is a standard corporate governance compliance filing. Small-cap pharmaceutical filings like this have no immediate financial impact on retail investors. Shareholders can review the passed resolutions through the exchange filing.
why_it_matters: No direct consequence for retail investors
